sites.name: Kargah Buddha
sites.what: Standing Buddha about 15 m high carved in the cliff of Kargah Nala, about 9.7 km from Gilgit (Gilgit-Baltistan Tourism Department). Smartraveller: Reconsider your need to travel to Pakistan overall; foreign nationals may not travel within 15 km of the Kashmir Line of Control, or within 50 km of the Afghanistan border in Gilgit-Baltistan; fly rather than drive to Gilgit-Baltistan (read 4 November 2026).

lore.text: Local legend says the figure is a man-eating giantess (yakshani) pinned to the cliff by a holy man.

sources.authority: Government of Gilgit-Baltistan, Tourism, Sports, Culture, Archaeology and Museums Department
sources.title: Kargah Buddha

sites.name: Manthal Buddha Rock, Skardu
sites.what: Rock carved with a Buddha, two Maitreya figures and 21 disciples, in Manthal village near Sadpara Dam (Gilgit-Baltistan Tourism Department). Smartraveller: Reconsider your need to travel to Pakistan overall; foreign nationals may not travel within 15 km of the Kashmir Line of Control, or within 50 km of the Afghanistan border in Gilgit-Baltistan; fly rather than drive to Gilgit-Baltistan (read 4 November 2026).
